newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares pause, awaiting budget clarification.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares pause, awaiting budget clarification.

text.p: Danish share prices closed virtually unchanged on Friday with trade restrained while the government retunes its 1997 budget plans.

"Complications with the budget give people an excuse to wait on the sidelines. Something needs to happen, for example a resolution of the budget issue, and then we'll be ready to rise again," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index crept up 0.02 point to 127.46 in overall bourse turnover of 616 million crowns. Its December future rose 0.30 point to 127.95 with 65 contracts, each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

The minority government's attempt to broker a joint budget package with Conservative opponents has broken down and it is now seeking to reshape separate elements in order to pilot them through parliament, each aimed at garnering support from different political camps according to its content.

None of the top-20 shares showed dramatic movement on Friday. Tele Danmark edged up 2.0 crowns to 289 after announcing that it had secured content for future cable tv operations through a joint takeover with Norway's Schibsted of Danish film, video and music producer Metronome.
